evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `fetchBaseBranch` runs `git fetch origin branch` with a colon-less refspec and no `--refmap=`. Git applies the remote's configured `remote.<name>.fetch` mappings to command-line refs unless overridden, so a configured mapping such as `+refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main` can force-update local `main` even though the explicit refspec has no destination. That is a real side effect/bypass of the protected-ref guard in existing fetch behavior, not a new requirement.
